rows.grounds: name of the Vedic Camaka recitation; object of recitation/dismissal context
instrumental of means indicating utterance or recitation
refers to the worshipped presence or ritual object being dismissed
compound praṇava-ādya qualifying the recitation; praṇava kept as mantra term

items.question: What recitation formula governs the ritual dismissal of the worshipped presence?
premises: The Camaka hymn is employed in the act of dismissal.
The recitation of the Camaka is performed as the means of dismissal.
The recitation is specified to begin with the praṇava.
items.inference: Therefore the worshipped presence should be dismissed by reciting the Camaka beginning with the praṇava.
uncertainties: The precise referent of asya depends on the immediately preceding ritual context.
items.plain_english: One should dismiss it by reciting the Camaka, beginning with the praṇava.
